summary: This is an 8-K filing by Nissan Auto Receivables Co II LLC and Nissan Auto Receivables 2026-A Owner Trust reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement for a securitization transaction. On May 20, 2026, the depositor (NARC II) and sponsor (NMAC) entered into an Underwriting Agreement with Wells Fargo Securities, as representative of the underwriters, for the issuance and sale of $1,268,450,000 aggregate principal amount of asset-backed notes (Classes A-1 through C) to be issued by the trust. The notes are registered under an SF-3 shelf and expected to close on May 27, 2026. The filing also notes a Purchase Agreement to transfer auto loan receivables to the issuing entity. This is a routine structured finance issuance, not a special situation.
